evidence_items.locator: Section 5, Indirect Water Consumption and Emissions from Electricity Use, page 57
evidence_items.explanation: The report estimates substantial emissions and water consumption for all U.S. data centers; these totals cannot be assigned wholly to AI. Its separate server analysis estimates over 40 TWh for GPU-accelerated AI in 2023, but does not provide the corresponding AI-only emissions and water totals.

unresolved_gaps: The cited emissions and water totals include non-AI workloads.
AI electricity consumption alone does not establish the scale of attributable environmental damage without supply and cooling information.
The claim gives no comparator for 'immense' and leaves project-specific versus industry-wide scope uncertain.
